description: Get the current local time, date, time-zone abbreviation and UTC offset in one to 20 places. Optionally compare each place with a reference location. Returns answer_url, a link to a page showing this answer live, to include in your reply.

from_place.description: Optional reference city, IANA time zone, abbreviation or UTC offset for difference_hours. Omit to return times without a reference comparison.

places.description: One to 20 cities, IANA time zones, supported abbreviations or UTC offsets, for example Copenhagen, Europe/London or UTC+02:00.

name: get_time

answer_link_markdown.description: A ready-made Markdown link to show the user. Translate the link text to the user's language if needed.

answer_url.description: Link to a page that shows this exact answer live. Include it in your reply to the user.

board_url.description: Link to the personal time-zone board with the answer items temporarily requested.

title: Get current time
